citation: Facebook, Inc. v. Power Ventures, Inc., 844 F.3d 1058 (9th Cir. 2016)
court: United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit
rule_established: After express revocation of permission, continuing access = 'without permission' under §502; §502 and CFAA operate in parallel; 'without permission' under §502 = 'without authorization' under CFAA
